rows.en:
...But the gym doors were shut tight.
Without a key, I can't get inside.{p}
What should I do?
All right, let's try the gym.{p}

First, I have to find the key.
Where will you go?
All right, let's try the gym.{p}

...The gym doors were shut tight.
But I have the key I brought from the staff room.{p}

I went into the gym.
With no lights on, the gym looked two or three times bigger than usual.{p}

It felt kind of eerie.
Come to think of it, countless students over the years had done their club activities here.
It wouldn't be strange if the grudges of those who'd aimed for a starting spot and never made it still lingered here.
But there's nowhere in here to hide anything.{p}What should I do?
Go to the gym storeroom
Go somewhere else
I'll search somewhere else.

I went into the gym storeroom and took a look.
...It smelled of dust.
The smell of dirty mats and vaulting boxes.
But there was nothing else.
I gave it a quick search, but there was no ampoule, and no one hiding either.{p}
I went back to the gym.
I went to the gym once more.{p}If anyone were hiding in a place like this, I'd spot them right away for sure.
I decided to go to the old school building.{p}

The old school building is huge.
Would I have enough time to search all of it?{p}Now, where should I go?
I decided to go to the old school building once more.{p}

...The old school building.
I may have a flashlight, but would I have enough time to search all of it?
Searching a building this huge without a single clue is next to impossible.
I gave up and decided to go somewhere else.{p}
Where will you go?
I went to try the third classroom from the left.{p}

I went into the classroom and shone my flashlight around inside.
Only a few scattered desks were left.
It didn't look like searching would take long.
First, I checked the teacher's platform.
...Nothing.
Next, I checked the remaining desks.
I searched every inch inside the desks, too.
...Nothing.
I searched every inch of the room, corner to corner.
It didn't seem to be in this classroom.{p}
